exposure: use of double-balloon catheter for induction of labor
outcome: interval between double-balloon catheter placement and vaginal delivery or CS
cohort: 40 pregnant women at term with a previous CS and Bishop score ≤6 for IOL with a double-balloon catheter
finding: Cervical length was effective in predicting vaginal delivery in women with a previous CS and low Bishop score following the use of a double-balloon catheter for IOL.
